description: This file defines the 'Thunder::Plugin::Probe' class and its nested classes, including WebTransform, Listener, Broadcaster, and Instance, related to network probing and Web request handling within the Thunder plugin framework.

classes.name: Thunder::Plugin::Probe
classes.description: Main class for network probing, broadcasting, and listening for Web requests within the Thunder plugin framework.

classes.name: Thunder::Plugin::Probe::WebTransform
classes.description: Handles transformation of Web request data for socket buffer processing.

classes.name: Thunder::Plugin::Probe::Listener
classes.description: Listens for incoming Web requests and responses, manages request validation and response creation.

classes.name: Thunder::Plugin::Probe::Broadcaster
classes.description: Sends multicast or broadcast Web M-SEARCH requests over the network.

classes.name: Thunder::Plugin::Probe::Instance
classes.description: Represents a discovered probe instance with URL, latency, model, and security info.

methods.name: Transform
methods.description: Transforms Web request data into socket data frames.

methods.name: LinkBody
methods.description: Attaches a body to a partial Web request.

methods.name: CreateResponse
methods.description: Creates a Web response based on incoming request.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Sends a ping broadcast to discover probes.

methods.name: SendData
methods.description: Prepares data to be sent over the socket.

methods.name: CreateRequest
methods.description: Creates a Web M-SEARCH request string.
